title: Measurement 1: Concentration Curves & the Detection Latency Budget

universe.eligibility_note: bitmap positions are T-3..T+3 (offsets [-3,-2,-1,0,1,2,3]), 1-indexed position 4 = offset 0 (T+0). clean_window is NOT applied as a filter for this measurement (D2) - the 287 event-day-only events are fully eligible.

session_calendar.note: Same pin and derivation range as config/phase_5.json. Regular session only (no half-day assumption - actual market_open/market_close pulled per session date from the mcal schedule).

session_date_derivation.note: Identical to research/phase_5/t2_trades_bitmap.py. Never crosses a UTC midnight boundary during XNYS regular hours, so this equals the NY session date.

opportunity_decay.open_price_definition: first in-session print (first trade at or after session open, before session close), per event per offset

opening_print_sensitivity.note: Escalation row 5: pooled median minutes-to-50%-move must not shift by more than 2x (either direction, i.e. ratio outside [0.5, 2.0]) when minute 0 is excluded from T4b/T4c recompute.

chart_overlay.rule: population > 200 events -> pooled curves + stratified per-event overlays; <=200 would get per-event charts per Agent_Prompt_Standard.md SS7 (not applicable this phase - D1 eligible population is far above 200)
chart_overlay.decile_source: momentum_pct deciles computed over the T1-eligible population (pd.qcut, 10 deciles, labels=False, duplicates='drop') - same qcut convention as research/phase_3/build_dev_sample_v3.py and research/phase_5a/t3_draw_primary.py

paths.sampling_frame_note: Phase 5a T2 already materialized momentum_events_canonical WHERE in_scope=TRUE AND source_file='file1' (D1, 15,763 rows, trades_bitmap/quotes_bitmap included). T1 reads this artifact rather than re-querying the canonical view, to avoid a redundant full-table-scan-cost VIEW hit (trades_ingested/quotes_ingested in the view are computed via DISTINCT scans over filtered_trades/filtered_quotes on every query). Row count cross-checked against the expected D1 total as a freshness guard.
